items.html: And from the parts that are for ZON, in them the ZON of Atzilut were made; and then all that remains is called dross relative to the world of Atzilut. And all these aspects go out in the secret of the blood of birth. However, there is still holiness in them, which is the aspect of the worlds of BYA; therefore they return and are clarified in the secret of Ibur within the Nukva of ZA, and from the choicest of it is made the AA of the world of Beria; and all the rest goes out from the Nukva of ZA in the secret of the blood of birth, and is called dross relative to Arich of Beria. And likewise in this manner, until the completion of the world of Assiya.
